items.text:
Since my original review of this game, the developers seem to have fixed pretty much all of my issues. I get a debug console pop up when I load my game, but I just hit F3 to close it and nothing seems to break, so that's fine with me.

Check it out, I've been having a lot of fun with it. Flying around in a salvage skiff ripping the expensive bits out of ships, selling them to pay off my dock fees at K-LEG, finding a ship in decent enough condition that it won't take me too long to get it liveable, all that ♥♥♥♥. There's also space weed.
items.text_zh:
自从我最初对这款游戏的评测以来，开发者似乎已经把我几乎所有的问题都修得差不多了。加载游戏时我会遇到一个调试控制台弹窗，但我只要按F3把它关掉，似乎什么都不会坏，所以对我来说没问题。

来看看吧，我玩得可开心了。驾驶一艘打捞小艇四处飞行，从飞船里拆下值钱的部件，把它们卖掉来支付我在K-LEG的停靠费，找到一艘状况足够好、不会花我太久就能让它变得宜居的飞船，所有这些♥♥♥♥。还有太空大麻。
